metadata.description: Lars' personal Claude Code skill toolkit (Werkzeugkasten).

plugins.name: repomix
plugins.description: Pack a folder as single AI-readable file for cross-project context.

plugins.name: security-auditor
plugins.description: Audit a skill or plugin folder for supply-chain risks (LICENSE, allowed-tools, bash calls).

plugins.name: mermaid-diagram-specialist
plugins.description: Generate Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, ERD, C4, state, Gantt) from text descriptions.

plugins.name: changelog-skill
plugins.description: Generate Keep-a-Changelog-conformant CHANGELOG.md from git log.

plugins.name: spike
plugins.description: Run a time-boxed spike answering one falsifiable question: charter gate, prediction before evidence, iteration budget, counter-checked verdict, enforced capture into a spike index. Parks questions via --stub.

plugins.name: taches-toolkit
plugins.description: taches commands + agents: consider:* thinking models, /audit-* (+3 auditor agents), /heal-skill, /create-*, /run-*, /whats-next, /ask-me-questions. As-is, reshape deferred.
